understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level and continue until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement uses directional actions on a grid while gravity pulls the player in the current direction. The player must avoid spike tiles, since landing on one ends the attempt. Each level allows 2 attempts with up to 50 turns; failed attempts restart the level and are recorded in context. Clicks and undo were not demonstrated in the available actions.
